title: A Tale of Two Identities: An Ethical Audit of Human and AI-Crafted Personas
findings: The paper does not focus on religion. An incidental finding from a log-odds ratio analysis (Table 3) shows that 'lord' and 'god' were identified as marked words in human-authored self-descriptions from participants in the Hispanic / Latino group.
